Coram : K.G. BALAKRISHNAN, P. SATHASIVAM, J.M. PANCHAL
A 8 Constitution of India, 1950 - Article 15 - Prohibition of discrimination on the grounds of religion, race, caste etc. - C Prospectus for Post-Graduate level medical courses issued by University in Haryana, not providing any reservation of seats for SC/ST candidates - Challenge dismissed by High Court- On appeal, held: Article 15(4) does not make any mandatory provision for reservation - State D Government is a competent authority to make reservation for SC/ST/backward classes category at Post-Graduate level in admission - It took conscious decision not to make
Decision Date : 02-12-2009 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7964/2009 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 3 Judges
